title: GTA 6 Is Rockstar's Longest Story Ever: About 80 Hours
short_description:
Rockstar North's Rob Nelson says GTA 6 took him about 80 hours: the main story plus a few side missions with story consequences, Rockstar's longest yet. HowLongToBeat players average about 51 hours for Red Dead Redemption 2's main story and about 32 for GTA V's. Different measures, so treat it as a rough comparison. No spoilers.

Sources: TechRadar, VICE, Beebom (HowLongToBeat averages).
